ORDINANCE XXV OF 1984
ELECTORAL ROLLS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Electoral Rolls Act, 1974.
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd June, 1984]
No. F. 17 (I)-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Electoral Rolls (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 28, Act XXI of 1974

ORDINANCE XXV OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXV OF 1984
ELECTORAL ROLLS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Electoral Rolls Act, 1974.
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd June, 1984]
No. F. 17 (I)-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 28, Act XXI of 1974.--In the Electoral
Rolls Act, 1974 (XXI of 1974), in section 28, for subsection (2) the following
shall be substituted, namely :-
"(2) Where
a form has been prescribed for any of the purposes of this Act or the rules
made thereunder, the Commissioner may, by notification in the official Gazette,
make such modifications or additions in the form as may in his opinion be
necessary;
Provided that
the validity of an electoral roll prepared in the prescribed form for the time
being in force shall not be affected by any modification or addition made in
the form subsequent to the preparation of the roll."
